fixes: Guide records whether card structure was requested; planner retries structural additions for appearance-only edits.
Builder output rejects unplanned added/removed/reordered cards.
Display-order index and follow-up instructions identify existing cards and include background videos.
Preview players remount when objectFit changes.
Shared dark and fill defaults; explicit Fit/Crop/Light and unrelated existing settings preserved.
